newsitem.title: SPAIN: Basque bank buys 1.5 pct of Repsol - press.
newsitem.headline: Basque bank buys 1.5 pct of Repsol - press.

text.p: A savings bank in Spain's Basque region, La Kutxa, has bought a 1.5 percent stake in energy group Repsol for 20 billion pesetas, a report in financial daily Expansion said on Tuesday.
No-one at La Kutxa was immediately available to comment.

The chairman of the regional savings bank, Fernando Spagnolo, told the paper that the investment is of a permanent nature. La Kutxa wants other savings banks to become stakeholders, lifting the participation to five percent, he said.
The stake was bought before December at an average price of 4,400 pesetas per share.
